text: The evolutionary-psychology thesis (Cosmides and Tooby) that the whole mind -- not just peripheral input systems -- is composed of many domain-specific, innate modules, with no domain-general central processor, is known as ___.
explanation: Massive modularity extends Fodor's modularity 'all the way up,' denying a general-purpose central reasoner. Fodor himself rejected it, holding that genuinely central processes (planning, belief revision) are isotropic and non-modular. It is thus distinct from Fodor's own thesis, which restricts modularity to input systems.
